title: Tesla signs $16.5B chip-making contract with Samsung

sources.quote: Samsung Electronics has entered into a $16.5 billion contract for supplying semiconductors to Tesla, based on a regulatory filing by the South Korean firm and Tesla CEO Elon Musk’s posts on X.

explain: Tesla will pay Samsung to manufacture its next-generation AI chips (AI6) at Samsung's new factory in Taylor, Texas. Samsung disclosed a contract worth about $16.5 billion running from July 2025 to the end of 2033 without naming the buyer; Elon Musk confirmed Tesla was the customer and said the real figure could be higher.
